profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer based out of San Diego working day-to-day with React, Express, SQL, and NoSQL databases. I am passionate about leveraging technology to create a meaningful positive impact. My most recent contribution was to Recolize, an open source Chrome Developer Tool for debugging applications built with Recoil state management library with over 1,000 weekly downloads on NPM and over 500 stars on GitHub.

Outside of coding, I enjoy playing video games and traveling to new places. 

Check out more of my repos at:
https://github.com/giovanacdlc

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to a Chrome Developer Tool for debugging applications built with Recoil state management library with over 1,000 weekly downloads on NPM and over 500 stars on GitHub

• Addressed technical debt and cleaned up complex legacy code by updating over 85% deprecated dependencies and removing unnecessary ones to ensure an optimized codebase and enable faster development

• Migrated the existing codebase from React 16 to React 17 and updated any dependencies to further establish maintainability
Deployed an updated NPM library with additional support for applications built with React 17 and 18 

• Improved test coverage from 17% to 80% using Jest unit tests to replicate user interactions with the application to ensure software quality, maintain code integrity, and enhance maintainability

• Migrated from Manifest v2 to Manifest v3 by transitioning to a service worker ensuring compatibility with future Chrome updates
positions.insights: React.js, React Testing Library and +5 skills

positions.title: Medical Scribe
positions.description:
• Developed a solid foundation in data entry and analysis by securely documenting patient information into the electronic health record quickly and efficiently

•Acted as a liaison between healthcare professionals and the IT department, facilitating effective communication and bridging the gap between clinical requirements and technical solutions.
positions.insights: Analytical Skills, Nonprofit Organizations and +4 skills

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer at Jacobs Medical Center in the Neuro PCU
volunteerExperiences.description: Supported medical personnel in the Neuro PCU to enhance patients' stay
Supported physical therapists, facilitated patient sessions, and documented patient information
